reviews.note: src/cli/workflow-sidecar.ts changed only how the checkpoint seal and render-trust-panel choose a Surface status function: both now re-derive a stored trust.bundle with the version stamped in its source instead of the installed Surface's default, and refuse a stamp the installed Surface cannot evaluate. docs/public-workflow-cli.md describes when and against which head checkpoints are sealed and never states which status function derives a sealed report or the trust panel, so every statement in it remains accurate.
reviews.limits: Source and document byte review only. Does not verify sealing or trust-panel rendering at runtime, and does not review other documents that cover this file.
